portraitFramePrompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: ONE transparent fantasy boss raid health frame with headshot.
Input 1 is a layout reference ONLY. Replace the METALLIC border entirely with fantastical magical organic artwork. Input 2 is Thessaly's boss identity and storm aesthetic.
ONE separate frame, centered horizontally on transparent 2172x724 canvas. Keep the approximate 2000px-wide compact silhouette of input1: circular portrait at far left about 370px diameter, connected to a long EMPTY very dark rectangular HP channel, roughly 145px tall, vertically centered.
Thessaly's pale silver-haired face and bright cyan eyes in portrait. Portrait border and bar edges formed from twisting translucent storm wisps, flowing ivory ghostly roots and fine lightning veins; elegant sculptural fantasy forms, slightly irregular organic curves and a few curling tendrils near portrait and endcap. High quality painted fantasy art. Border is more expressive and magical than plain rails, but thin enough for practical raid HUD. Slate purple, pale ghostly ivory, subtle electric cyan light. Dark nearly black empty channel clearly separated inside; keep inner channel edges straight so a dynamic HP fill fits. Leave at least 50px transparent padding around all edges; nothing clipped.
NO metal, bronze, gold, steel, rivets, screws, engraved machined rails, industrial parts, huge wings, sprawling silhouette, text, numbers, labels, health fill, background, or multiple frames. Actual alpha transparency outside.

Preserve canvas size, layout, colours, silhouette, every border pixel, and positioning. No replacement background, checkerboard pattern, black panel, fill, text or new effects. Deliver one complete transparent PNG frame overlay to render real game health UNDERNEATH it.
